question: As of March 14, 2024, which of the following is Asia's longest tunnel?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Zojila Tunnel**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Zojila Tunnel** is set to become Asia's longest bi-directional tunnel upon its completion. It is located in the Union Territory of **Ladakh**, India, and connects **Srinagar** with **Leh**.
 
• The tunnel is part of the **NH-1** project and is being constructed at an altitude of approximately **11,578 feet**. It aims to provide year-round connectivity between **Sonmarg** in Jammu & Kashmir and **Drass** in Ladakh, which otherwise remains cut off during winter due to heavy snowfall.
 
• The length of the Zojila Tunnel is approximately **13.14 kilometers**, making it the longest road tunnel in Asia.
